subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped revisions for credentialed token, Docker-publish, CodeQL, repository-mutation, and Codex-agent actions be accepted together after the branch is refreshed and exact-head checks pass?
rationale: These actions execute across security and credential boundaries, and the repository carries a protected security label requiring explicit human ownership even though no concrete patch defect was found.

options.title: Approve grouped update
options.body: Refresh the branch and accept all immutable revisions after direct upstream and sibling-Codex review plus successful exact-head checks.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, and Codex action changes from routine tool-setup updates for narrower security review.

options.title: Hold existing pins
options.body: Defer the grouped update until maintainers can exercise the affected privileged workflows independently.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped update
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and accept all immutable revisions after direct upstream and sibling-Codex review plus successful exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows the broadest ownership across action modernization, Docker release hardening, CI behavior, and Codex-backed docs automation.
